svg.title: Strobe Assistant - one conversational turn
svg.text: “Find me the photos of my dog”: from question to answer, with the identity check made twice.
wss /acp · authenticate with the ID token
verify signature · issuer · audience · expiry → keep sub
verify the token again → userId = sub (never a tool argument)
query both indexes · filter by userId · fuse with RRF
ConverseStream with the tool result → grounded answer
trust boundary: the token is verified here, not trusted
